text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
戦争が始まってしまうだなんて……
親を喪う子が、いったいどれほど出るか……
text.official_en:
War. I couldn't have imagined... How many children
will be left grieving lost parents?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
策をたくさん考えて進言しておかなくちゃ。
少しでも犠牲者を減らしたいもの。
text.official_en:
I feel like I can't do much, but I'm going to work on
strategies that could reduce casualties.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あわわわわ……
ほ、本物の戦争だあ……
text.official_en: A war? A real one?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
覚悟は決めたはずなんだけど……
やっぱり足が震えちゃうな……
text.official_en:
I mean, I think I'm ready to fight, but... Oh, man.
My legs feel like jelly.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
大丈夫よウルタンド……アウロラ様も
わたしの家族も、ちゃんとダグシオンを出た……
text.official_en:
I'm fine. Aurora, my family, all of them got out of
Dagsion before it was too late.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だけどやっぱり、これからそのダグザ帝国と
戦争だって思ったら、落ち着かないわ……
text.official_en:
But, I can't calm down. Knowing we're about to go to
war with the Dagdan Empire...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
どうか、みんな無事でいて……
わたしも絶対に、生き残るから……
text.official_en:
Please be safe. We're all going to survive. No matter
what it takes...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ヒハハハ！　帝国と戦争か。
いったいどれほど惨い戦いになるのかな？
text.official_en:
Heh heh HEH! Goin' to war with the empire. This is
bound to be atrocious!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
まあ何にしても……殺される前に、殺してやるさ。
この“地獄のジェスター”がね。
text.official_en:
No matter what happens, the Infernal Clown's going
to give better than he gets.
text.real_en:
No matter what happens, the Jester of Hell's going
to give better than he gets.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゴライアス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
俺っち一人でも、
帝国の大軍を蹴散らす自信があるぜ。
text.official_en: I betcha I could rout the empire's army on my own.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゴライアス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ダグシオンじゃ、神殿兵どもの前を通るだけで、
縮み上がらせてたくれえだからな。
text.official_en:
I mean, the temple soldiers back in Dagsion used to
shrink when they saw me walk past.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゴライアス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
“牛殺し”の恐ろしさを、
嫌ってほど味わわせてやるぜ！　ブハハハハ！
text.official_en: I'll put a real scare into these soldiers too! Bwahaha!
text.real_en: I'll show you just how terrifying the Ox-Slayer can be! Bwahahaha!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゲイツ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ダグザ大帝が再び姿を現したと思えば
一気に戦乱の時代の到来か……
text.official_en:
With the return of Emperor Dagda, it appears an
era of war has begun.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゲイツ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
いかに力があろうとも、私の目に、大帝は
魅力的な人物とは、とうてい映らんな……
text.official_en:
Dagda the Great is a powerful figure, yes...but a
despicable one.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゲイツ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ここまで来たら、もう後には引けぬ。
補佐は私に任せるがいい。
text.official_en:
We've come too far to pull back now. Entrust me
with anything you need.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ぼくは幸運だ。
このダグザの地で空前の戦いが幕を開け……
text.official_en:
I feel so fortunate! An unprecedented conflict is
kicking up in Dagda...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それをこれから、
間近で体感することができるのだから。
text.official_en: and I am alive and present to experience it up close!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
善も悪も余すところなく取材し、
後の傑作に役立てるとしよう。
text.official_en:
I will document everything, virtue and evil alike,
and weave them into my masterpiece!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ダグザ大帝は大義を欠いた上で、
半ば強引にこの戦争を始めました。
text.official_en:
Dagda the Great does not merely lack any form of
ethics—he deliberately instigated this war.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
絶対に勝利するという傲慢さ故か……
大義の有無などに頓着しない粗暴さ故か……
text.official_en:
Perhaps it is simply arrogance that drives him... He
assumes victory. But don't discount base amorality.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
まあ、その両方でしょうな。
獣らしいことこの上ありません。
text.official_en:
Most likely it is both in combination, I suppose. The
superlatively vulgar nature of a beast.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ダグザ大帝の奴が戦争始めて
母さん、怯えてるだろうな……
text.official_en:
My mom must be scared, what with Dagda the Great
starting this war.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
フィーナの漁村は端っこのほうだから、
戦火に巻き込まれたりはしないだろうけどさ。
text.official_en:
Good thing Fina is so far out of the way. I can't see
war coming there anytime soon.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
何にせよさっさと終わらせたいね。
親孝行にもなるだろ？
text.official_en:
But let's get this thing done with as soon as we can!
I don't want my mom to worry.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
この場に立っている……ということは、明確に
帝国と敵対する意思を持つ、ということです。
text.official_en:
The fact that you're standing here suggests you
intend to stand against the empire.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それは分の悪い賭けですが……ヴァンダル商会が
そういった決断を嫌うわけではありません。
text.official_en:
It's a gamble, but that isn't to say the Vandahl
Trading Company is averse to such decisions.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
危険な賭けほど、大きい利益を生む……
それこそが商売の本質というものなのですから。
text.official_en: The greater the risk, the greater the profit, after all...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ダグザ大帝、起きて早々に戦争始めるとはね。
どんだけ頭に血が上りやすいんだよ……
text.official_en:
Didn't think Emperor Dagda would start a war this 
quick. Guy gets pissed off fast.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
年食った奴の寝起きがろくでもないのは
大将がいい例だが、比べ物にならねえな。
text.official_en: Cranky as the boss gets waking up, this is next level.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ルルディヤー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
帝国側であるお父様と戦うかもしれないけど、
仮に相対したとしてもルルは逃げない。
text.official_en:
My father's on the other side... Even if we come face
to face on the battlefield, I won't run away.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ルルディヤー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だって敵前逃亡は家の恥だもの。
そんなことしたらお父様は悲しまれるはず……
text.official_en:
Because my father would rather trade blows with me
than see me run from a fight.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ルルディヤー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
でも、どうか会いませんように……
本当は戦いたくない……
text.official_en:
Even so, I pray we don't meet. If I can help it, I'd
prefer not to fight him...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まさか、神威大帝様がこれほど一方的に
戦争を始めてしまわれるなんて……
text.official_en:
I can't believe that the Divine Emperor would begin
a war so outright.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
お話に聞いていた頃から恐ろしい方だとは、
思っていましたが……
text.official_en:
I knew he was a frightening person when I 
heard the stories about him...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ダグザの地を守護してきたサラミス王国を
滅ぼそうとは正気を失っているとしか思えません。
text.official_en:
But Saramis protects Dagda. Trying to destroy it is
completely insane.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……祈ります。
大帝様が思い直してくださることを……
text.official_en: I pray that he reconsiders.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディエゴ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
………………
為すべきことを為すだけだ。
text.official_en:
I must now...continue on. I'll do what I need to,
simple as that.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディエゴ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ハル・ハリの戦士らしく、帝国軍と戦う。
それが今の、俺の役目だ……
text.official_en:
I was a Har Hali warrior once. I'll be a warrior
again, fighting the imperial army.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ロレッタ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……オレも戦うぜ。
正直言うと、まだちょっと怖えけど。
text.official_en:
I've got to fight. I have to...no matter what. Doesn't
mean I'm not scared though.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ロレッタ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
一番偉い神さまだからって、
いきなりたくさんの人をぶっ殺し始めるとか……
text.official_en:
I mean, we're facing up to the most powerful god
ever, that's all. But he wants to kill tons of people!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ロレッタ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そんなの、絶対に間違ってる。
きっと祭司サマなら、そう言うはずなんだ。
text.official_en:
It's just wrong. Completely wrong. I know that the
priest lady would think so!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
この地でも動乱が起こってしまった……
人と神による戦争が……
text.official_en:
Chaos has broken out in this land—a war between
gods and humans.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
私はダグザ大帝を止めようと思う。かつて、
十傑たちとの苛烈な戦いに身を投じた時のように。
text.official_en:
I intend to stop the Divine Emperor Dagda, just as
I once fought the 10 Elites of another time.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……恐らく、この場にいたのが私ではなく
彼女だったとしても、同じ決断を下していただろう。
text.official_en:
If she were here, rather than me, I know she would
make the same decision now.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ニネ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
戦争………………
きっと数え切れないほどの人が、死ぬのね。
text.official_en:
War is in the air... People will die... Countless
numbers of people.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ニネ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ニネにできるのは、
戦うことと、祈ることだけ。
text.official_en:
I can fight. I can pray. I sense that both will be
required.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ニネ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
死せる魂のために……
そして、ユ・ファス様のために……
text.official_en:
I will do it for all the dead souls—and in memory
of Yu Phas.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
サラミス王国存亡の危機……有体に申せば、
そう呼べる変事は幾度かありました。
text.official_en:
This is only the latest in a line of existential crises
for the kingdom of Saramis.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
サラミス王国存亡の危機……これまでにも
そう呼べる変事は幾度となくあった。
text.official_en:
This is only the latest in a line of existential crises
for the kingdom of Saramis.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
しかし我々はそのすべてを打破して参りました。
先王セルヒオ様と、そして陛下と……
text.official_en:
Whether it was under the late King Sergio or Your
Majesty, we have overcome them all.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
しかし我々はそのすべてを退けてきた。
先王セルヒオ様と、陛下と、そして我々とでだ。
text.official_en:
We have always survived through the guidance of
the late King Sergio, then Her Majesty.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
このボナパルテ、セオドラ様の軍師として、
必ずや勝利をもたらすと誓いましょう。
text.official_en:
I vow to use my expertise as Your Majesty's tactician
to emerge victorious this time as well.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
このボナパルテ、軍師としての身命を賭して
此度の戦いに、必ず勝利をもたらすと誓おうぞ。
text.official_en:
I vow to use my expertise as a tactician to emerge
victorious this time as well.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ぬおおおおおお！！　モーザの次は帝国だー！
相手にとって不足はないわー！
text.official_en:
Yeesh! First the Mosa, now the empire?! How come
everyone wants to kill us all the time?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
みんなでたらふく肉食って、気合入れて行くぞー！
見とってくれ、ユ・ファス様ー！
text.official_en:
Let's eat well and get fired up for battle! Yu Phas,
watch over us!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ホントに帝国と戦うコトになっちゃうとはねー……
正直アタシ、ちゃんと考えてなかったなー。
text.official_en:
I'd never have thought we'd actually have to fight
the empire. Can't say I'm surprised, though.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まーケド、これも仕事のウチだしー。
戦争する覚悟なんて、とっくにできてるしー。
text.official_en:
Well, I'm being paid to fight, and I'm not picky about
who. I've been ready for war for a long time.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……アタシの故郷を焼こうなんて、絶対許せないし。
帝国のヤツら、倒してやろーじゃん。
text.official_en:
And if they're coming to burn down my home,
they'll have to go through me first.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ライサンダー
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
サラミスへの宣戦布告……
神威大帝は、我々を皆殺しにするつもりだ。
text.official_en:
A declaration of war on Saramis is essentially the
Divine Emperor's death warrant for us all.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ライサンダー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
陛下の御身は、必ずお守りする……！
我が身に代えてでも！
text.official_en:
I will protect my queen's life...even if I must sacrifice
my own to do so.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
サラミスに迫っているのは、
「シドニア事変」を遥かに上回る規模の、大軍です。
text.official_en:
The army marching on Saramis is far larger than the
forces involved in the Cydonia Massacre.

text.official_en:
The Divine Emperor is scary as they come. I hear
he executed a priest who raised an objection...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イニオニ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
たったそれだけのことでいちいち殺していたら、
部下が何人いても足りないでしょうに……
text.official_en:
He won't have many people around left to serve
him if he kills people over little things like that.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
昔の仲間も、この戦争に参加しているのかね。
敵味方に別れるなんて、考えたくもないけど……
text.official_en:
I wonder if any of my old comrades are fighting in
this war. I'd hate to think we'd be on opposite sides.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
こればっかりは傭兵の常だ。
呑み込むしかないね……
text.official_en:
I guess it's just the life of a mercenary. There's a
lot you just have to accept with this work.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ある意味でこの命は、
セオドラ様に救われた命です。
text.official_en: I owe the queen of Saramis a great deal.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
故に今はジュラ神殿の天翼兵ではなく、
一人の騎士として、戦おうと思います。
text.official_en:
I fought for Jurah as a wing soldier. But now, I am
simply a knight here, proud to serve!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……昔、両親に教わったんです。
『助けてくれた人は、絶対助けてあげなさい』と。
text.official_en:
When I was very young, my parents taught me to
help those who have taken time to help you.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ダグザ大帝に舌を引き抜かれ、
体を刻まれたという臣下は私もよく知る男だった。
text.official_en:
I knew a man whose tongue was ripped out by
Divine Emperor Dagda.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
特別親しいとまでは言わないが、奴は聡明で、
私と趣味も合った。時々盤上遊戯に興じたものだ。
text.official_en:
We weren't close, but he was a smart man and we
sometimes played board games together.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
最期となってしまった進言、
何ひとつ間違ってはいないというのに……
text.official_en:
He did nothing wrong. Yet, petitioning the
Divine Emperor was the end of his life.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
戦争で取引先が駄目になったりして、
ヴァンダル商会、潰れねえかな……
text.official_en: <#CTRL:0E>

そうなったら……ふふ、カカカカ！
万歳！　ざまあみろってんだ！！
text.official_en: <#CTRL:0E>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キロイカ

text.jp:
やったぜ、潰れたぞ！　やったー！　カカカカ！！
………………はあ、虚しい。
text.official_en: <#CTRL:0E>

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌッツォ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
目覚めて早々ダマスカルの地を蹂躙しようとは……
やはりダグザ、許すことはできぬ……
text.official_en:
We cannot allow Dagda's first act after awakening be
to overrun the land of Damascar.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌッツォ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
われも力を尽くす。
サラミスの王より受けた恩に、報いねば。
text.official_en:
I will fight to the last of my strength to repay the
debt I owe to the queen of Saramis.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
帝国軍との戦い……私のような新兵が、
生きて帰れるとはとても思えません……
text.official_en:
Doesn't seem like us new recruits have much of a
chance of making it out of this one alive.

text.jp:
でも、冥府にはお優しいユ・ファス様が
いらっしゃるんですよね？
text.official_en:
But we have Yu Phas looking out for us in the
underworld, right?

text.jp:
だったら、大丈夫なんじゃないかしら……
うん、そんな気がしてきました！
text.official_en:
In that case, maybe it won't be so bad. Yeah...I gotta
see the positive side of things.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
セオドラ陛下は、ダグザ大帝の宣戦布告に
決して屈しない道をお選びになった。
text.official_en:
My queen has chosen the path of no surrender
against Dagda the Great's declaration of war.

text.jp:
サラミスの勇士として、私も賛同していますが……
ダヤン王子なら、どのような判断をしたでしょうな？
text.official_en:
As a warrior of Saramis, would I feel the same if it
were about any of Prince Dyan's commands?
text.real_en:
As a warrior of Saramis, would I feel the same if it
were about any of Prince Dayan's commands?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
我々は長きにわたり“ダグザの盾”として
多くの血を流しながらこの地を守ってきた。
text.official_en:
We've defended this land for a long time as the
Shield of Dagda, and lost many lives in the process.

text.jp:
私の父も、兄も、子でさえもそのために死んだ！
誇りある責務であると、ずっと信じていたのに！
text.official_en:
My father, my brother, and even my child all died for
the cause. Yet I always believed it to be a noble duty.

text.jp:
それを今更、『盾など無用』などとっ！
おのれ、おのれぇ……っ！
text.official_en:
Only now do they say "we don't need a shield."
Those double-crossing bastards!
